title: Copy-loop exit states
statement: The exit state after the copy loop is the phase-zero loop at the second node-copy site after the first node-copy site, and the node-reading state after the second node-copy site. At the return-copy sites it is the phase-zero loop at the second return-copy site, carrying the same child value, then the quantifier-reading state carrying that value; after copying depth for a literal it is the phase-zero subtraction loop carrying the polarity, and after copying the stack it is the phase-zero halving loop carrying the polarity.
hypotheses_covered: copy-loop site is one of the six constructors, with its Boolean parameter where applicable
